note: FortiWeb GUI pages that read a collection through the GUI's own API (/api/v2.0/<x>, answered 500 by cmdb) while the same objects live in a cmdb collection SATOM caches, edits and audits. Measured 2026-10-09 on fortiweb17 (7.6.8 build1128) and fortiweb18 (8.0.6 build116), GETs only. confidence: 'measured' = the same objects on both sides, or every key of the layout among the build's measured fields; 'named' = cmdb twin by name and by the SATOM menu entry with the same label, both sides empty on the lab. keys: GUI key -> cmdb key ('measured' = equal on every row; 'label' = the column title names the cmdb field). computed: columns FortiWeb computes, no cmdb field holds them.

waf/signatures.evidence: Same 16 (fortiweb17) and 10 (fortiweb18) signature sets by name on both sides.
waf/signatures.key_evidence: alertOnlyCount / signatureDisabledCount equal on every row with varying values; the other five equal on every row (16/16, 10/10) with constant values.

waf/openapi.openapischemafile.evidence: Same 6 OpenAPI files by name on fortiweb17; both empty on fortiweb18.

system/certificate.ocsp_sign_certs.evidence: Every layout key among the measured fields of the cmdb collection on 7.6.8 and 8.0.6; both empty on the lab.

system/certificate.xmlservercertificate.evidence: cmdb GET 200 on both builds, empty; SATOM menu entry 'XML Certificate' (xml_server_certificate).

system/certificate.xmlclientcertificate.evidence: cmdb GET 200 on both builds, empty; SATOM menu entry 'XML Certificate' (xml_client_certificate).

system/certificate.tslca.evidence: cmdb GET 200 on both builds, empty; SATOM menu entry 'CA' (certificate_tsl_ca).

system/certificate.intermediateca.evidence: cmdb GET 200 on both builds, empty; SATOM menu entry 'Intermediate CA' (system_certificate_intermediate_certificate).

wvs/wvspolicy.evidence: cmdb GET 200 on both builds; both sides empty on the lab.

time/0.evidence: The GUI reads system/maintenance.systemtime (timeZone, daylightSaving, the clock) and was measured writing Set Time / Sync Interval to cmdb system/ntp. On fortiweb17 (7.6.8) and fortiweb18 (8.0.6): system/ntp holds ntpsync + syncinterval, system/ntp/ntpserver the server table (pool.ntp.org on both), system/global timezone '04' = GUI timeZone 4 and dst 'disable' = daylightSaving 0. The 8.0.6 crawl tied the server table to system/admin; corrected here.

set.label: Automatically adjust clock for daylight saving changes

fortisandbox/0.evidence: The crawl named the FortiGuard object the page also reads; all 6 layout keys (type, server, cache-timeout, email, interval, region) are measured fields of system/fortisandbox on 8.0.6 and its single object answers 200.

automation/0.evidence: The crawl bound no collection (newer GUI shell). Columns Name / Status / Trigger / Action Count / Description are fields of system/automation-stitch (measured on 8.0.6: name, status, trigger, sz_action_member, comments); 8 stitches on both labs.

live.policy/serverobjects.global.predefinedda: FortiWeb's predefined data types (46): GUI API only, cmdb has no collection (500).
live.policy/serverobjects.global.predefinedgl: FortiWeb's predefined global allow list: GUI API only; the cmdb group collection holds the user's groups, not these entries.
live.wvs/scanhistory: Web Vulnerability Scan history: GUI API only, cmdb has no collection.
